item.title: Trump says U.S. is postponing some strikes as it negotiates end to war with Iran
item.summary: The president’s announcement sent markets up and energy prices diving, as investors bet Iran’s blockade of a key shipping chokepoint could soon end.

item.title: At least one winner emerges from Iran war: U.S. natural gas exporters
item.summary: President Donald Trump’s “energy dominance” agenda gets a boost as governments in Asia scramble to substitute Middle East fuel.

item.title: Trump threats, U.S. troop build-up raise specter of battle for Hormuz
item.summary: Israelis said securing the strait for energy shipments could become the war’s main goal now that regime change and ending Iran’s ability to obtain a nuclear weapon seem out of reach.

item.title: Joe Kent says he wants Trump to hear MAGA opposition to Iran war
item.summary: In an interview with The Post after resigning from the administration in protest, the veteran said he is taking his message to the president’s supporters.

item.title: Trump threatens to ‘obliterate’ Iran’s power plants if Strait of Hormuz does not open
item.summary: Iran’s military said it would respond to strikes on Iranian energy infrasturcture with counterattacks against U.S.-linked energy facilities in the region.

item.title: Why Iran does not appear ready to give in, despite heavy losses
item.summary: Tehran’s unwillingness to capitulate as the war enters its fourth week is wrapped up in the power it exerts over the Strait of Hormuz, officials in the region say.

item.title: Ambulances set ablaze at London synagogue in attack Starmer calls antisemitic
item.summary: No one was hurt in the blaze, which damaged four ambulances operated by a Jewish charity in north London’s Golders Green neighborhood, officials said.

item.title: When my friend came home from Maduro’s torture prison
item.summary: The Washington Post’s Venezuela reporter writes on a couple divided by the authoritarian regime in Caracas — and their joyful reunion.
